reason: Repair all three fresh design-review findings: prove actual committed/staged/unstaged/untracked scope, bind release authority to structured operator/rights/mailbox evidence rather than statuses, and enforce exact schemas/nullability plus retained-value redaction.

lanes.proof_role: Prove exact schemas, artwork/source bytes and properties, allocation, truthful pending gates, and every actual BASE...HEAD, staged, unstaged, and untracked path against the declared allowlist.
Reject unknown fields, invalid pending nullability, prohibited retained scalar values, credentials, private mailbox content, codes, and private-key material across the exact packet.

Fail closed unless an exact approved-title decision and confirmation digest, concrete rights basis/license/source owner/operator confirmation, and mailbox control/receive/sender/provider/retention evidence all exist and agree; status changes alone cannot pass.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred and expected to fail while operator title, rights confirmation, or mailbox control/receive evidence remains pending; publication is prohibited until this exact lane passes.

lanes.proof_role: Prove patch hygiene after the validator has independently proved the complete actual path set against the immutable current-main preparation base.
